source: docs/design/alternate_history.md section 7 (V1 to V13) and docs/specs/04_mechanics/realm_life.md. The ranges are the design's; the values of each draw, the chances, the temper traits and their texts are proposed (25 October 2026). The owner allowed at most two small border feuds between minor realms under the full rule (K34). modules/start_variety.mjs builds the game files from this file.
applyNote: The draws are made once in on_startup (common/on_actions/zin_start_variety.txt sorts after zin_rules.txt, which sets the story pace). They are applied three days later by the hidden event zin_variety.1, after the owners' own start values: Aenor, the Council and Zol set theirs from on_startup events, Volgan and Lerendor on day 1, the heir's waking on day 2, and the West and the Gathering Dark in on_startup files that sort after this one.
aiOnly: Under LIGHT a drawn change that lands on one realm (a temper) is made only for AI realms. Under FULL (owner answer Q-92, K59) the tempers, feuds, disputed lands and bonds reach player realms too.

V4.weightNote: Owner answer Q-91 (K59): a larger set of tempers with rarer ones. Each temper is drawn by its weight (default 10; the uncommon 4, the rare 2, the rarest 1).

V6.note: The grudges of the design: the orc and goblin holds of the Dark Lands, the Troll Forest among its neighbours, and the Triton island lordships (Adel and Fineger stay out: the Western Crossing counts on them). A feud needs two AI realms of one group that share a border.

V8.note: Each pair: one border state that is not a capital may start with the other claimant, who borders it; the giver keeps its core and gains a claim.

bold.name: Bold-Hearted
bold.desc: Rides at the head of the host and expects the council to keep up.

cautious.name: Cautious
cautious.desc: Counts the granaries twice before giving any order that cannot be taken back.

pious.name: Pious
pious.desc: Hears every rite of the temples and keeps a priest at the elbow in council.

grasping.name: Grasping
grasping.desc: Finds a tax, a fee or a fine for everything, and remembers who has not paid.

scholarly.name: Scholarly
scholarly.desc: Would rather read the old charters than ride out to inspect the levies.

vengeful.name: Vengeful
vengeful.desc: Keeps a list of every slight to the crown and means to answer each of them.

generous.name: Generous
generous.desc: Gives feasts, alms and pardons with an open hand, and the treasurers despair of it.

weary.name: Weary
weary.desc: Has carried the crown a long time and would be glad to set it down.

just.name: Even-Handed
just.desc: Hears both sides of every quarrel before giving judgement, and both sides grumble that it took too long.

suspicious.name: Suspicious
suspicious.desc: Trusts no one at court, tastes nothing twice, and keeps a list of every lord who smiles too often.

ambitious.name: Ambitious
ambitious.desc: Means to leave the realm larger than it was found, and has had the old maps of every border brought up from the archive.

idle.name: Idle
idle.desc: Leaves the writs to the clerks and the wars to the captains, and spends the summers hunting.

cruel.name: Cruel
cruel.desc: Rules by the gallows and the dungeon, and the court goes very quiet at the sound of the royal step.

silver_tongued.name: Silver-Tongued
silver_tongued.desc: Can talk a hostile envoy into a treaty and a hungry crowd into going home.

builder.name: Builder
builder.desc: Cannot pass a ruined wall without ordering it rebuilt, and keeps the masons of half the realm in the crown's pay.

stern.name: Stern
stern.desc: Drills the levies in person at dawn and has never once been seen to laugh.

melancholy.name: Melancholy
melancholy.desc: Sits for days in a darkened room, and comes out with verses that nobody at court understands.

fortunate.name: Fortune's Favourite
fortunate.desc: Has come through a fall from the saddle, a fever, two battles and a poisoned cup, and the common folk say the gods are fond of the crown.

touched.name: Touched
touched.desc: Hears voices nobody else hears and gives orders no captain would dare to give, and some of them have turned out to be brilliant.

beloved.name: Beloved of the People
beloved.desc: The common folk would follow their ruler into the sea, and the lords know it.
